checks.text: With no input, the page shows the heading "JSON Schema Validator", a button labelled "Validate", and the text "No validation results yet".

Typing `{"name": "Alice"}` into the textarea labelled "JSON Data" and `{"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}}}` into the textarea labelled "Schema", then clicking "Validate" shows the text "Validation passed" and hides "No validation results yet".

Typing `{"name": 123}` into the textarea labelled "JSON Data" and `{"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}}}` into the textarea labelled "Schema", then clicking "Validate" shows the text "Validation failed" and a list item containing "name: expected string, got number".

Typing `{"age": 25}` into the textarea labelled "JSON Data" and `{"type": "object", "required": ["name"]}` into the textarea labelled "Schema", then clicking "Validate" shows the text "Validation failed" and a list item containing "name: required field missing".

Typing `{"code": "ABC123"}` into the textarea labelled "JSON Data" and `{"type": "object", "properties": {"code": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3}$"}}}` into the textarea labelled "Schema", then clicking "Validate" shows the text "Validation failed" and a list item containing "code: does not match pattern ^[A-Z]{3}$".

Typing `{"value": 150}` into the textarea labelled "JSON Data" and `{"type": "object", "properties": {"value": {"type": "number", "minimum": 100, "maximum": 100}}}` into the textarea labelled "Schema", then clicking "Validate" shows the text "Validation failed" and a list item containing "value: 150 is greater than maximum 100".
Typing `not json` into the textarea labelled "JSON Data" and clicking "Validate" shows the text "Invalid JSON in data field" and does not show "Validation passed" or "Validation failed".
After a successful validation with "Validation passed" visible, clicking the button "Download Report" triggers a file download named "validation-report.json" containing the text `"status":"pass"`.

Reload keeps the last validation result: after validating `{"name": "Alice"}` against a valid schema to show "Validation passed", reloading the page still shows the text "Validation passed" and the same JSON and Schema text in their respective textareas.
